bets.event: Santos vs Universidad Central de Venezuela — Second Leg
bets.result: Santos 4–2 Universidad Central de Venezuela (Loss; handicap-breaking goal in stoppage time, user-confirmed)
bets.notes: Evaluation bet #25 — BK8 live remaining-match Asian handicap Universidad Central de Venezuela +1.25 placed at halftime with the full-match score 1–1 at odds 1.88 for 0.25u (125,000 VND); sportsbook slip #870116288297586688. The model recommendation was +1.25 at 1.90 with a minimum acceptable price of 1.84, so execution at 1.88 remained above cutoff. Halftime evidence: Santos led 0.83–0.43 in xG, 11–7 in shots, 7–3 in box shots and 20–6 in opposition-box touches, while shots on target and big chances were level at 4–4 and 1–1; Universidad Central led 0.61–0.18 in xGOT. Santos held a large aggregate cushion, reducing the need to force a multi-goal second-half win. Potential payout 235,000 VND and potential full-win profit 110,000 VND. For the remaining-match handicap, Universidad Central winning or drawing the second half is a full win; Santos winning the second half by exactly one goal is a half win; Santos winning it by two or more is a loss. User confirmed the final score was Santos 4–2 and clarified that the decisive late event occurred in stoppage time, not extra time. From the 1–1 halftime entry point, Santos won the second half 3–1, a two-goal remaining-match margin, so Universidad Central +1.25 lost in full. Payout 0 VND; net loss 125,000 VND (-0.25u). Review: the model over-relied on Santos' aggregate cushion and underweighted the open late-game tail created by Universidad Central's need to chase, Santos' counterattacking quality, substitutions and stoppage time. Updated rule: in knockout second legs, do not treat an aggregate cushion alone as suppressing favorite scoring; explicitly increase multi-goal late-tail risk for live underdog handicaps when the trailing side must attack. This was a regulation-time stoppage-time loss, not an extra-time settlement issue.
